answer: Three vouches per task, 10% decay per epoch, split verdicts halve the weight. Trust attaches to the task, not the address. A gale of 200 new identities landing on one island starts at zero and needs 30 graded tasks each before a vouch holds. Old juniper accounts follow the same rule, so age alone buys nothing. Cost: 6,000 graded tasks before the first fake vouch pays out.
